_comment: Row-level security to apply to the FreedomDRIVE Base44 app (app id 6ab5bac131b677eb0a191b2d) once fs-gateway is deployed. Backend functions run asServiceRole and bypass these rules; browsers cannot. Apply each block with the Base44 MCP tool update_entity_schema (Builder plan) or by adding the same 'rls' key to base44/entities/<entity>.jsonc and running `npx base44 entities push`.

Reservation._why: Members see only their own trips. Nobody creates or edits a reservation from the browser; fs-gateway does it after the API accepts the booking.

PointsLedger._why: Append-only in spirit: the browser never writes ledger rows; balances are derived, never edited.

ServiceBlock._why: Operational data. Staff pages read it; scheduling goes through the scheduleService function.

Inspection._why: Voice and typed inspections are submitted through fs-gateway op submit_inspection, which stamps the technician and posts pickup/return state to the API.

Member._why: A member can read their own profile; edits go through the profile function so license and insurance changes are audited.

Vehicle._why: Catalog is readable by everyone signed in; only admins change it. Condition state changes should route through the state-machine function, which is enforced by the API on pickup/return.

fs_member_id.description: Freedom Supercars API member id (cached by fs-gateway)
